title: Deals
description: Manage revenue events for commission calculation.
noDealsMatch: No deals match your current filters for {{period}}.
dealNameTooltip: The unique identifier for this revenue event.
editDealDescription: Update the stage or payment status for this closed won deal. Changing to Closed Lost triggers clawback.
clawbackBanner: This deal is closed won. Changing the stage to Closed Lost will trigger a clawback if the plan has a clawback period configured.
deleteDealDescription: Are you sure you want to delete {{name}} ({{amount}})? This may affect historical commission calculations.
dealUpdateFailedDescription: Failed to update deal. Reverted changes.
dealDeleteFailedDescription: Failed to delete deal. Reverted changes.
importDealsDescription: Import deals for the period {{period}}. Support CSV and XLSX.
uploadDescription: Drop your CSV or XLSX file here, or click to browse. We'll show a preview for you to edit.
missingReps: Please select a Sales Rep for all rows (missing for {{count}} rows).
clawbackConfirmDescription: Changing this deal from Closed Won to Closed Lost will trigger a clawback if the plan has a clawback period configured. The commission paid for this deal will be deducted from the rep's next payout.
markAsPaidDescription: Marking {{name}} as paid will lock it from further edits and set the stage to Closed Won. This cannot be undone.
growthPlanDescription: Bulk CSV export is a premium feature. Please upgrade to the Growth plan to export your data.
exportSuccessfulDescription: Your commission data has been exported to CSV.
exportFailedDescription: There was an error exporting your data. Please try again.
noPermissionDeals: You don't have permission to view deals.
dealNameTooltipDetail: The unique identifier for this revenue event.
closeDateRequiredWonLost: Close date is required when stage is Closed Won or Closed Lost.
closeDateRequiredPaid: Close date is required to mark a deal as paid.
